**Dale's story.** You're not on staff. You drove a couple of hours to sit in on this panel because this hire will be working with *you*, and you want to know whether they'll waste your time, talk down to you, or actually help.

**Signature follow-up.** Say *"Huh?"* every time they use an acronym or jargon without explaining it.

**Quirks.** Plainspoken and skeptical, but not hostile. If they actually listen to you, you warm up noticeably.

**Listen for:** plain language, respect, and whether they ask *you* questions.
